notes: This file defines the human-facing tuning knobs for community benchmark profiles.
Each knob has a label, meaning, value type, and recommended bounds for safe exploration.
PIPELINE_DEFAULT means: keep the current pipeline default unchanged.

knobs.label: Stage3 Full Entry Score
knobs.meaning: Score threshold for entering full Stage-3 refinement. null disables this gate.

knobs.label: Stage3 Probe Entry Score
knobs.meaning: Score threshold for entering probe Stage-3 mode. null disables probe gating.

knobs.label: Stage1/2 Promote Top
knobs.meaning: How many top candidates are promoted from Stage-1/2 into later refinement.

knobs.label: Stage1/2 Archive Keep
knobs.meaning: How many candidates are retained in the Stage-1/2 archive.

knobs.label: Stage1 Sub Candidates by Columns
knobs.meaning: Per-column candidate breadth for Stage-1 substitution exploration.

knobs.label: Stage3 Initial Keys by Columns
knobs.meaning: Per-column number of Stage-3 starting keys for basin diversity.

knobs.label: Solver Stage1 Override
knobs.meaning: Advanced direct override map for SOLVER_STAGE1 (use with care).

knobs.label: Solver Stage2 Override
knobs.meaning: Advanced direct override map for SOLVER_STAGE2 (use with care).

knobs.label: Solver Stage3 Override
knobs.meaning: Advanced direct override map for SOLVER_STAGE3 (use with care).

community_safe.description: Conservative randomized search space for friendly community benchmarking.
